posts.body:
Asset Request: Characters
Maker Format: RPGMaker MZ
Makers I Own: XP,VX,Ace,MV, MZ
Art Style:
https://despairparty.itch.io/rpgmaker-spriteface
A blend of RTP and something like this.
Description: I was looking for Non-Human NPCs for my game. I made some using the character Generator though the idea was that they were going to be some NPCs that were Oni and Beastfolk in particular. I downloaded some DLC with more friendlier looking Oni enemies but they only came with the faces and enemy portraits rather than actual walking characters.
Reference Images:
I also have me 'Frankenspriting' a set up with some of the Enemy Monster types from a DLC as well as three Oni NPCs I made with the character generator.
--Removed paid DLC resource--
You can see the inconsistency. The idea were Oni versions specifically of the standard villagers ('People' in the RPGMaker MZ file) though the Oni in this series are a predominantly male race where 1 in every 6 Oni are actually women.
